account: Law 160/2019, article 1, paragraphs 681–686, provides the legal basis for VeRa, “verifica dei rapporti finanziari”. In its operating guidelines of 20 June 2022, the Agenzia delle Entrate wrote that Ve.R.A. would deliver new selective lists to every regional and provincial office for ordinary audits. Offices were to report the outcome of each flagged case on a feedback form so that the Agenzia could check the selection model. A model for partnerships and companies that had already been piloted was to be refined. Fiscomania (Elisa Migliorini, 15 May 2026) states that the algorithm became operative under the ministerial decree of 28 June 2022. The decree was adopted after hearing the data protection authority (Garante) and the Agenzia. On 29 July 2022 Denaura Bordandini and Massimo Borgobello described VeRa in Agenda Digitale. They called it a new AI-based application to help Agenzia delle Entrate officials fight tax evasion. It cross-matches the Archivio dei Rapporti Finanziari with other tax-registry information. Preliminary analysis uses pseudonymized data. The data are not irreversibly anonymized. Under the decree, analysis datasets are kept until the second year after tax-assessment powers expire and, where relevant, until litigation is resolved. According to Fiscomania, the Settore Analisi del rischio of the Divisione Contribuenti runs the system. It produces selective lists of taxpayers at higher fiscal risk by crossing data on financial relationships, declarations, assets and electronic payments. Taxpayers are handled under a pseudonymous code during the preliminary phase. Fiscomania gives targets for 2022 under Italy's national recovery and resilience plan (PNRR): 2,581,090 communications, 2.45 billion euro in expected receipts and 5% fewer false positives than in 2019. It reports no results. No source through October 2026 reports the results of the feedback forms or any audit or evaluation of Ve.R.A.

Neither gives the technique or any result, so the algorithm's contribution cannot be assessed. The Agenzia both runs and, as far as the sources show, operates the system in-house.
